notes: Difficulty is moderate. Substance comes from pinning down the exact lexicographic-stable topological order (Kahn with min-heap tie-breaking), the intervention semantics (intervened node ignores parents and is set to the intervention value), cycle detection, and exact decimal arithmetic rounded to six places half-up. Hidden cases probe a fresh diamond graph, a cyclic graph, an isolated node combined with a lexical tie, and a fractional rounding-heavy input. The implementation is a single self-contained Python computation with no IO beyond reading two CSVs and writing one JSON, so dependency stages, tool breadth, resource pressure and statefulness are low (0-1). Implementation-style ambiguity (multiple correct-looking orderings, integer-vs-float and rounding conventions, how to handle interventions on absent nodes) is the main difficulty, hence debugging_ambiguity=2, adversarial_inputs=2, hidden_case_generalization=2, quantitative_correctness=2.
